title: Installment Publication
description: Seller-reported proof that a digital installment (creator post, newsletter edition, podcast episode) was published: when, and where. Echoed on a by_installment delivery row. Seller-reported unless verified_by names an independent verifier. Evidence only: it is not by itself a billing event, because billing follows the accepted terms.

published_at.description: When the installment was first published.

posts.description: Each place the installment was published. Cross-posts are separate entries. A buyer can pass an entry to sync_creatives for paid amplification.

evidence.description: Optional capture or archive of the live post.

verified_by.description: Independent verifier of the publication. Absent means the record is seller-reported.
